name: Samurai Jack
description: A great warrior is displaced to the distant future by the evil shape-shifting wizard Aku. The world has become a bleak place under the rule of Aku, segregated into fantastic tribes and ruled by Aku's evil robot warlords. Jack travels this foreign landscape in search of a time portal that can return him to his home time so he can "undo the future that is Aku!".

videos.title: I
videos.overview: When Aku is reborn to set forth his reign of terror, the Emperor's son is sent off to learn the ways of the samurai. That boy becomes a man and attempts to slay Aku with a mighty sword, but Aku banishes him to the future.

videos.title: II
videos.overview: The Samurai lands in the future and is named Jack. He is enlisted by a race of dogs to destroy Aku.

videos.title: III
videos.overview: Jack gets weapons and beats back Aku's army of beetles saving the canine race.

videos.title: IV
videos.overview: Jack helps free the Woolies from the tyrannical Chritchellites.

videos.title: VII
videos.overview: Jack must get past three blind archers to reach an all-powerful wishing well.

videos.title: V
videos.overview: When Jack mistakenly destroys a group of scientists' chance to escape Aku, he and the scientists join forces to try and fix the problem, hopefully returning Jack home as well.

videos.title: IX
videos.overview: Jack has an underwater adventure with a jelly-whale and sea monkeys while hunting foran ancient time portal.

videos.title: X
videos.overview: Jack goes through a cave full of challenges only to find an old warrior longing to reach Valhalla.

videos.title: VIII
videos.overview: Jack meets up with Mad Jack and must battle his darker self.

videos.title: XI
videos.overview: When Jack and a Scotsman meet on a never-ending bridge, they end up shackled together and on the run from bounty hunters.

videos.title: VI
videos.overview: Jack and a mysterious woman go on a quest in an attempt to resolve their personal goals.

videos.title: XII
videos.overview: Jack hooks up with some Chicago gangsters to try and get close to Aku.

videos.title: XIII
videos.overview: Aku tells fairy tales to the children to try and win them over to his side instead of Jack's.

videos.title: XIV
videos.overview: Jack comes upon a monkey-man and agrees to train his tribe in the ways of defending themselves if the monkey-man teaches him how to "jump good".

videos.title: XV
videos.overview: Three short stories: Jack vs. the Worm: Jack confronts a two-headed riddling serpent who will grant him his wish if he can answer their questions;  The Metal-Eaters: Jack confronts a family that feed on metal and eat Jack's sword; Jack, the Gargoyle and the Fairy: Jack tries to rescue a wish-granting fairy from a gargoyle so that she may grant his wish to return home.

videos.title: XVI
videos.overview: Jack is kidnapped and placed in a chain gang of warriors chosen to battle in front of a coliseum audience against the Dome of Doom's Champions.

videos.title: XVII
videos.overview: The Scotsman needs Jack's help to save his kidnapped wife. But this woman is hardly the distressed damsel the Scotsman makes her out to be.

videos.title: XVIII
videos.overview: Jack goes from destroyed village to another looking for those responsible, only to find the destruction was commissioned by Aku.

videos.title: XIX
videos.overview: Jack comes upon ruins of a village and realizes it is his home. He then reflects on the past when he was a young boy.

videos.title: XX
videos.overview: Jack travels vertically up a mountain with three monks to witness the magic of the mountain only to have the power of the mountain save his very life.

videos.title: XXI
videos.overview: When a flatulent dragon begins stinking out an entire village. Jack slays the beast and ventures inside it to cure to source of its bellyache.

videos.title: XXII
videos.overview: Aku hires the best hunters in the galaxy to track down the most elusive of prey - Samurai Jack.

videos.title: XXIII
videos.overview: Aku sends out Demongo, the soul collector, to destroy Jack. Now Jack must fight all the mighty warrior souls that Demongo has collected.

videos.title: XXIV
videos.overview: When Jack has his sword and clothing stolen, he must give chase to a white rabbit who took them while trying to maintain his modesty.

videos.title: XXV
videos.overview: Jack comes upon a battle where a mere 300 men are fighting a vast, unending army of robots and their evil robotic leader.

videos.title: XXVI
videos.overview: When a band of bikes mow over Jack's sandals, he goes on a hunt for the perfect footwear.

videos.title: XXVII
videos.overview: Jack is turned into a chicken by a cranky wizard. While he tries to fix this, he gets caught by a "handler" and becomes a prize-winning Creature Combat fighter.

videos.title: XXX
videos.overview: Aku leads Jack to a graveyard where the dead begin to rise. An evil spirit takes over Jack's sword, leading Jack to defend himself against his own weapon. When Aku gets hold of the sword, Jack fears he's finally met his end.

videos.title: XXVIII
videos.overview: When a man's daughter is kidnapped by Aku's Children, Jack must infiltrate a rave to stop the musical brainwashing.

videos.title: XXIX
videos.overview: Jack boards a train to his next destination only to be attacked by a couple of arguing bounty hunters.

videos.title: XXXI
videos.overview: Jack must read hieroglyphics, solve riddles and assemble a sacred scarab to call upon Ra for help in fighting evil ancient Egyptian shadow warriors.

videos.title: XXXII
videos.overview: Jack must travel along a water creature, a mountain creature and a flying creature to get to a portal to return home. But once he reaches the portal, it is guarded by an undefeatable warrior who tells him that this portal is not for him.

videos.title: XXXIII
videos.overview: An over-friendly creature begins following Jack, messing up Jack's every move along his quest.

videos.title: XXXIV
videos.overview: Jack and a Swamp Wizard travel to the four corners of the earth, collecting pieces that are meant to get Jack home. But when Aku reveals himself to be the Swamp Wizard, Jack must battle these pieces which are now being puppeteered by Aku's evil hands.

videos.title: XXXV
videos.overview: When Jack enters a spooky, old mansion and gets locked inside, he catches sight of a figure and sets after it to find out what is going on. As Jack is led further and further in, he discovers that the house and its inhabitants have an evil plan that involves…him.

videos.title: XXXVI
videos.overview: Jack falls into a hidden temple sanctuary to find monks trained like him in the style of the Ancient Master. The Ancient Master's Son then tells Jack of a portal to send him home, but in order to use it, his new friends must be sacrificed.

videos.title: XXXIX
videos.overview: Jack is directed to a deathtrap-filled labyrinth which holds a diamond that can restore him to his time. Unfortunately a master thief also enters the labyrinth going for the item.

videos.title: XL
videos.overview: Aku sends a Ninja to destroy Jack who is busily helping a port town in distress.

videos.title: XLI - Robo/Mondo - Bot
videos.overview: Jack enters a village to discover that he is their Chosen One meant to embody the Robo-Samurai and destroy the Mondo-bot that has come to destroy them.

videos.title: XLII
videos.overview: Jack is approached by a cool Samurai-punk who wants to battle with Jack in order to prove that he is the best.

videos.title: Birth of Evil
videos.overview: When ancient gods try to destroy a powerful evil, they send one piece of the beast hurtling through space. This piece lands on earth, spreading its evil through the land. When it encroaches on an Emperor's empire, he takes it upon himself to destroy the evil, but ends up unleashing the evil that is Aku.

videos.title: Scotsman Saves Jack
videos.overview: Jack has lost all memory of who he is and it's up to the Scotsman to put the pieces of the puzzle together to save the samurai.

videos.title: XLIII
videos.overview: When Aku catches a cold and sneezes on Jack, Jack becomes infected with Aku’s badness which begins to take over his entire body.

videos.title: XLIV
videos.overview: When Aku raises the bounty on Jack, the best bounty hunters in the world gather to capture him.

videos.title: XLVII
videos.overview: Jack helps save a Prince and Princess whose ship has been shot down to Earth by Aku.

videos.title: XLVIII
videos.overview: Tired of all the bounty hunters and robots failing, Aku fights Jack, mano y mano.

videos.title: XLIX
videos.overview: As Jack goes through fall, winter, spring and summer, he must battle the perils that each season brings.

videos.title: L
videos.overview: Aku forces an old, ace robot assassin out of retirement to eliminate the ultimate mark - Jack.

videos.title: LI
videos.overview: Young Jack is brought to Africa for part of his training, but when his tribe is abducted, he must learn how to use their unique sword-like weapon – and fast!

videos.title: LII
videos.overview: Jack finds a baby and the two travel together as Jack tries to return the boy to his mother.

videos.title: XCII
videos.overview: It's been 50 years since we last saw Samurai Jack and time has not been kind to him. Aku has destroyed every time portal and Jack has stopped aging, a side effect of time travel. It seems he is cursed to just roam the land for all eternity. His past haunts him as well as a cult of assasins dedicated to killing him for Aku's glory.

videos.title: XCIII
videos.overview: Jack's will to survive is pushed to its absolute limits after a deadly, unseen foe launches a relentless surprise attack.

videos.title: XCIV
videos.overview: Samurai Jack is gravely injured, but still decides to face one of the deadliest foes he's ever faced, Assassins from the Cult of Aku.

videos.title: XCV
videos.overview: Samurai Jack partners with a deadly assassin in order to escape a gargantuan creature that has swallowed them whole.

videos.title: XCVI
videos.overview: Samurai Jack fights to save a group of enslaved people from being harvested as the power source for a monstrous Mega-Robot.

videos.title: XCVII
videos.overview: Ashi's search for Samurai Jack helps her to see his effect on the world after encountering numerous people and places where he has changed things for the better

videos.title: XCVIII
videos.overview: Jack and Ashi overcome a series of dangerous physical and spiritual tests in order to recover Jack's sword.

videos.title: XCIX
videos.overview: The burgeoning relationship between Jack and Ashi takes a turn after they are hunted by one of the galaxy's deadliest creatures.

videos.title: C
videos.overview: Samurai Jack's worst fear is realized when he faces off against Aku; the demon makes a shocking discovery about Ashi that puts her in grave danger.

videos.title: CI
videos.overview: The fate of the entire universe hangs in the balance as Samurai Jack faces Aku.

awards: Won 8 Primetime Emmys. 20 wins & 13 nominations total
